title: Floor area limitations on additional uses
previewText: The additional uses allowed pursuant to Section 144-11 (Additional Uses Allowed in M2 Districts) shall be limited to 300,000 square feet of floor area within each Subdistrict where such additional uses are allowed, and the total floor area allocated to such additional commercial uses shall not exceed 100,000 square feet in each Subdistrict where the additional uses are allowed.
